source.title: Irish News, 20 May 1964, p. 7 ("County and rural council nominations: Dungannon")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: 'All the 13 outgoing Unionists ... had unopposed returns for Dungannon Rural Council', with six Nationalist nominations, one for each Nationalist division (Irish News, 20 May 1964, p. 7)

note: Triennial election of Dungannon Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. There was no contest: all thirteen outgoing Unionists were returned unopposed, and six Nationalists were nominated, one for each Nationalist division (Irish News, 20 May 1964, p. 7, which lists every nomination under the headings 'Nationalist nominations' and 'Unionist nominations'; the labels are those headings). All nineteen divisions are recorded. Returned unopposed.
